items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48358 (Arbitrary Code Execution via webhooks) and CVE-2026-48356 (Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type), which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding in Adobe Commerce Webhooks leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution due to improper output encoding in the webhooks component of Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows attackers to upload malicious files, such as webshells, to the server, potentially leading to further compromise and data theft.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) affecting multiple versions of Adobe Commerce, allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component, which can be triggered remotely without authentication or user interaction, leading to application crashes.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical security vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise customer accounts.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation.
